name: GHD Sit-Up
steps: Sit on the glute-ham developer pad with your feet locked securely between the ankle rollers and your hips positioned slightly ahead of the pad.
Keep your knees slightly bent, brace your abs, and lower your torso smoothly backward past horizontal toward the floor.
Reach back under control until your hands touch the floor or you reach your comfortable end range.
Drive your knees forcefully straight while flexing your trunk forward to sit up and touch the footpads.
tips: Control the backward descent smoothly rather than dropping rapidly into hyperextension.
Build range and volume gradually because the extended eccentric stretch places high demand on the abs.
